summary: Phase 8.6 Security Hardening RETEST (iteration 17) — focused on the 3 fixes + 2 previously-skipped scenarios from iteration_16. New focused suite tests/test_phase86_retest_iter17.py: 11/11 PASSED. Bug #1 verified: require_super_admin is now strict — super_admin gets 200 and role='admin' gets 403 on GET /api/admin/audit-logs, /api/admin/login-history, /api/admin/security/summary. Bug #2 verified: failed login (wrong password AND not_found email) now writes audit_logs entry with action='auth.login', status='failure' and details.email (lowercased) + details.reason ('bad_password' or 'not_found'). Bug #3 verified: PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/role writes audit_logs with action='role.change', status='success', details.previous_role and details.new_role; endpoint is gated by require_super_admin so a role='admin' caller correctly receives 403. No regressions observed in backend logs.
action_items: All three previously-reported bugs are fixed and verified. No further action needed for Phase 8.6 security hardening fixes.
Naming deviation (auth.signup vs auth.register) is intentionally kept per main-agent note — no change required.
critical_code_review_comments: security.py: require_super_admin now does strict equality check on role=='super_admin' — correct.

routes/auth.py: failure paths (not_found and bad_password) now write BOTH login_history (success=false) AND audit_logs (action='auth.login', status='failure') with email lowercased + reason — correct.
routes/admin.py: PATCH /users/{id}/role now uses Depends(require_super_admin) and emits log_event(action='role.change', status='success', details={target_user_id, previous_role, new_role}) — correct.
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of TEST_iter17_*@dwaarit-test.com users via /api/auth/signup during the retest (admin-role user, role-change targets, victim). Prefixed TEST_iter17_ for easy cleanup.
